title: 第1544章 捋虎须下第1543章 捋虎须上
content_zh:
但长卿不退反进，抬手一挥，一道毒障如刀子般挥出，挡在身前，勉强拦住了魏九凤剑气虚影挥来的一剑。
只是拦下这一剑的长卿看上去也不好过，他身形向后倒飞出去，口中也忍不住吐出一口鲜血，显然已经受了伤。
魏九凤的剑气虚影仍旧在身后穷追不舍，长卿还没稳住身形，只能以剑戟竹来抵挡，却都被魏九凤的剑气虚影如砍瓜切菜一般撕了个粉碎。
这一瞬间的喘息之机也让长卿稍微调整了一下身形，数道毒影流光自周身飞出，主动攻向那袭来的剑气虚影，将其退路全部封死。
但这并没能拦住魏九凤，剑气虚影只是随意几招，便将长卿射来的毒影流光全部化解，剑气虚影转而再度朝长卿飞去。
“枯木逢春。”
长卿身上亮起一道深紫色光芒，脚下巨大的黑金铁木再次拔地而起，而魏九凤那剑气虚影的身形一闪，直接劈向了硕大坚固的黑金铁木。
“蠢货，在那样的高手面前想要故技重施怎么可能成功！”
擂台边缘的骨幽姬见状，忍不住在心中骂道。
刚刚林念荷就用过这招，提前在半空中布下手段，同时在脚下竖起坚固的黑金铁木，在黑金铁木将他送至半空之后，还能利用绵里针让自己继续停留在空中。
一边改换自身的位置，一边也能给剑气虚影制造障碍，帮他拖延了不少的时间。
虽然长卿留在空中的众多绵里针就如云朵一般，数量众多体积庞大，绵延颇远，长卿藏身其中自下而上看去魏九凤一时间未必能找到长卿本体。
但只要魏九凤稍微催动剑气虚影，全力向上攻击，将那些绵里针统统斩落也不过是几招的事情。
然而就在魏九凤的剑气虚影斩碎那黑金铁木，正准备继续向上攻击时，异变突生。
长卿不知何时，竟然出现在了那破碎的黑金铁木之后，距离魏九凤的剑气虚影仅一步之遥。
魏九凤的剑气虚影虽然看似精妙，但本质上还是剑气，而不是活生生的人，在魏九凤将注意力集中在半空中时，即便长卿近在咫尺，剑气虚影同样会疏于防御。
长卿双掌凝聚出两道毒光流影，对着面前的剑气虚影直接挥去。
情急之下，魏九凤只能控制着剑气虚影向后躲闪而去，但就在这时，长卿身上再次亮起一道深紫色的光芒。
“万紫千红。”
随着万紫千红的催发，原本半空之中漂浮着的绵里针竟开始纷纷激射出毒刺。

只是毒刺的目标不是那向后退去的剑气虚影，而是魏九凤的本体。
“叮叮当当”的几声下去，魏九凤的头顶悬浮着数不清闪烁着幽芒的毒刺，尽数被她指尖的剑气所挡住。
而就是这一瞬的疏忽，原本被魏九凤控制的剑气虚影，此刻已经被长卿掌中的两道毒光所命中。
剑气虚影被毒光一挥，胸前立刻缺失了一块，不过随着其周遭剑气的补充，马上就恢复如初，只是没有先前那般凝实了而已。
长卿一招挥出，收势不及，同时被那剑气虚影的一剑抵在了脖颈处。
然而众人想象中长卿尸首分离的场面并没有出现，剑气虚影的一剑只是稳稳停住了而已。
魏九凤的表情变化了一瞬，而后指尖一挥，头顶的毒刺被她纷纷甩落。
“你，很不错。”
她开口说道。
content_en:
But Changqing did not retreat but advanced instead. With a wave of his hand, a poisonous barrier was swung out in front of him like a knife, barely blocking the sword swung by Wei Jiufeng's sword energy shadow.
However, Chang Qing, who blocked the sword, didn't look well. He flew backwards and spit out a mouthful of blood. He was obviously injured.
Wei Jiufeng's sword energy phantom was still chasing behind him. Changqing had not yet stabilized his body, so he could only use his sword, halberd and bamboo to resist, but was torn to pieces by Wei Jiufeng's sword energy phantom like chopping melons and vegetables.
This moment of respite also allowed Chang Qing to slightly adjust his body shape, and several poisonous shadows flew out from around him, actively attacking the incoming sword energy shadow, blocking all its retreat routes.
But this did not stop Wei Jiufeng. With just a few random moves, the sword energy shadow resolved all the poisonous shadows shot by Chang Qing, and the sword energy shadow flew towards Chang Qing again.
“Withered trees come spring.”
A deep purple light lit up on Changqing's body, and the huge black gold iron wood rose up from the ground again under his feet, and Wei Jiufeng's sword energy shadow flashed and struck directly at the huge and solid black gold iron wood.
"Idiot, how can you succeed if you try to repeat your old tricks in front of such a master!"
When Gu Youji on the edge of the ring saw this, she couldn't help but cursed in her heart.
Lin Nianhe had just used this trick, deploying means in mid-air in advance, and at the same time erecting strong black gold iron wood under his feet. After the black gold iron wood sent him into the air, he could also use the cotton needle to keep himself in the air.
While changing his position, he could also create obstacles for the sword energy shadow, which helped him delay a lot of time.
Although the many cotton needles left by Changqing in the sky are like clouds, numerous in size, and stretching far away, it is impossible for Wei Jiufeng to find Changqing's body when Changqing hides in them and looks up from the bottom.
But as long as Wei Jiufeng slightly activates the sword energy shadow and attacks upward with all his strength, it only takes a few moves to cut down all those cotton needles.
However, just when Wei Jiufeng's sword energy phantom shattered the black gold iron wood and was about to continue attacking upwards, a sudden change occurred.
Changqing didn't know when, but he appeared behind the broken black gold and iron wood, only one step away from Wei Jiufeng's sword energy shadow.
Although Wei Jiufeng's sword energy phantom looks exquisite, it is still sword energy in essence, not a living person. When Wei Jiufeng focuses his attention in mid-air, even if Chang Qing is close at hand, the sword energy phantom will still neglect defense.
Chang Qing condensed two poisonous light streams with his palms and swung them directly at the sword energy shadow in front of him.
In desperation, Wei Jiufeng could only control the sword energy to dodge backwards, but at this moment, Changqing's body once again lit up with a deep purple light.
"A riot of purple and red."
With the stimulation of colorful reds, the cotton needles that were originally floating in the air began to shoot out poisonous stings one after another.
It's just that the target of the sting is not the retreating sword energy shadow, but Wei Jiufeng's body.
“叮叮当当”的几声下去，魏九凤的头顶悬浮着数不清闪烁着幽芒的毒刺，尽数被她指尖的剑气所挡住。
And due to this moment of negligence, the shadow of the sword energy originally controlled by Wei Jiufeng was hit by the two poisonous lights in Changqing's palm.
The sword energy phantom was swung by the poisonous light, and a piece of its chest was immediately missing. However, as the sword energy around it was replenished, it immediately returned to its original state, but it was not as solid as before.
Changqing swung out a move, but failed to recover it in time. At the same time, the sword of the sword energy was pressed against his neck.
However, the scene of Changqing's body being separated as everyone imagined did not appear, and the sword qi shadow's sword just stopped steadily.
Wei Jiufeng's expression changed for a moment, and then she waved her fingertips, and the stings on her head were thrown off one after another.
"You are very good."
she spoke.
